additionalGroups.group: original Expo UI and modifiers forwarding
additionalGroups.boundary: Original wildcard forwarding remains unchanged; actual selected controls/navigation/events and SDK-only import/render passed. This is not exhaustive upstream UI semantics.

All 13 mapped adapters have actual selected native assertions. Controlled dismissal describes binding transitions rather than animation completion; FullScreenCover/Inspector do not certify every system dismissal.
GroupBox, EditButton and EmptyView passed native assertions. DefaultDocumentGroupLaunchActions remains deliberately unmounted in the non-document Host; no document creation result is claimed.

Every effective factory is linked to parameters, native Record/registry and exact forwarding body. Eleven selected observable assertions passed; the other 72 remain native-context/source/type coverage without individual OS-effect proof.

Current installed metadata agrees in the real Host. Historical real stale-version red/green checks remain historical evidence, not rerun claims. Frozen legacy tools-only multiRuntime metadata is unchanged.

All 33 names remain direct original reexports. init/runOnUI/defineUIKitView/defineUIViewController participate in the real UIKit/Worklets fixture; other methods have forwarding identity/type contract coverage without per-method native execution.

Five runtime executions, real storage and installed action success/error/recovery passed. Modern widget publication is persisted/catalog-visible/reload-requested with osRendered:null; legacy positional storage is not modern publication.

Original Mini parity/storage/relaunch and lifetime cases passed. Separate current NS5 imports the generated typed facade and calls all five engines. This does not establish every cancellation/Live Activity/OS-entrypoint combination.

Actual mailbox, scene, nested-modal and owner-lifetime cases passed. Saved complete/cancel receipt and return-to-source open outcome remain separate; not every JS wrapper method on both engines is individually exercised.

additionalGroups.group: HostServices Live Activities versus original expo-widgets
additionalGroups.boundary: Original expo-widgets timeline/isolation and ActivityKit lifecycle case passed. HostServices probe establishes enable/list reads, not wrapper start/update/end. SpringBoard placement, Lock Screen/Dynamic Island rendering and physical-device acceptance are not inferred.

hostServicesMethodBoundaries.coverage: Installed real Hermes handlers acknowledge success, actual error and later recovery. Notification ingress/queue assertions are native in-process delivery; they do not establish OS push or tap.
Shared public types/interfaces for real native surface routes. These types are not a claim that each OS surface or rendering permutation was exercised.

rawCaptureBoundary: The unchanged source-capture script retains its historical baseSHA and NOT_RUN/PENDING fields verbatim. The actual current invocation command and this derived reconciliation are the authority for current source and later native results. Parser/source analysis alone is not compiler or native execution.
